title: Family Services Center Guidance on Meal Benefit Applications and Income Verification — School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
**Applications.** A household may submit a meal benefit application at any time in the school year, and School Nutrition Services determines it within 10 operating days; the support desk records a submitted application but never determines it.

**Approved applications only.** A status that rests on a household application is applied to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account only from an application whose determination is approved for free meals or approved for reduced price. The application record's determination is the authority; a caller's statement that the application "went through" does not replace it.

**Verification.** By October 1 (the verification selection deadline) the district selects approved household applications for income verification; only statuses that can be selected for verification (Reduced-Price Meal Status and Free Meal Status (Household Application)) can be selected, and a selected household has 10 calendar days after the selection letter to send documents.

**Outcome.** When verification confirms the status, nothing changes; when it supports a lower status, or the household does not respond, the status is lowered with the decrease reason verification result under the adverse action notice period.

**Denials.** A denied application leaves the current status unchanged.

## Determination outcomes

| Determination on the application record | Status applied from it |
|---|---|
| approved free | Free Meal Status (Household Application) |
| approved reduced | Reduced-Price Meal Status |
| denied | none; the current status is unchanged |
| not yet determined | none yet |

## Verification outcomes

| Verification result | Effect |
|---|---|
| status confirmed | nothing changes |
| supports a lower status | lowered, decrease reason verification result, after the notice period |
| no response from the household | lowered, decrease reason verification result, after the notice period |
